correctness.rationale: Petersen KG(5,2) has ten 2-subset vertices and 15 disjointness edges. All proper named palette assignments were directly enumerated: 120 at k=3 and 12960 at k=4. Every legal single-coordinate recolouring was constructed, yielding 60 edges at k=3 (every state degree one) and 53280 at k=4. Independent full-source BFS across all 12960 four-colour states found connected graph with radius 13 and diameter 14, eccentricity multiplicities 3360/9600, exactly 44400 unordered diametral pairs, and every one of the stated 14 distance-shell counts. Git source includes a separate 11-orbit construction via S5 and colour-label canonicalization; 11 table orbits sum to 12960. This is an exhaustive finite proof with defined complete adjacency generation, not partial enumeration.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof or priority proof.
